column1: # DOI normalization vectors. Single source of truth for Scala (DoiVectorsContractSuite) and Python.
# Encoding: UTF-8, LF, no BOM. Cells: input, expected (REJECT or normalized DOI), note.
# Escapes (left to right): \\ backslash; \uXXXX one UTF-16 unit (4 hex); \UXXXXXXXX one non-surrogate code point (8 hex); \e whole cell = empty string.
# Any other backslash sequence is a reader error; a high \u escape immediately followed by a low \u escape is a reader error.
